tasks.label: Backend: installer dépendances
tasks.command: cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt

tasks.label: Backend: migrer la base de données
tasks.command: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python manage.py migrate

tasks.label: Backend: lancer le serveur (dev)
tasks.command: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python manage.py runserver

tasks.label: Backend: lancer avec WebSockets (Daphne)
tasks.command: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && daphne -b 0.0.0.0 -p 8000 config.asgi:application
